app.tagline: The security boundary is wired. Build your app inside it.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHelp: Choose how the app looks. System follows your operating system.

language.title: Language
language.help: Choose the interface language. System follows your operating system.

proxyMode.label: Proxy mode
proxyMode.help: Off (default): same-format bindings connect directly; usage isn’t counted. On: routed through AiOpt’s proxy; usage is counted.

warnOnQuitWithProxy.label: Warn before quitting with proxy active
warnOnQuitWithProxy.help: On (default): if agents are routed through AiOpt’s proxy, confirm before quitting — they can’t connect until AiOpt runs again. Off: quit without asking.

account.title: Account
account.signedOutHelp: Sign in to connect this device. The local stub accepts any username and password.
account.error: Sign-in failed. Check your details and try again.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.recording: Press the new shortcut… (Esc to cancel)

check-for-updates.label: Check for Updates
check-for-updates.description: Check whether a newer version is available.

toggle-theme.label: Toggle Light / Dark
toggle-theme.description: Switch between the light and dark appearance.

errors.notBindable: That key can't be used on its own. Add a modifier, or use a function key.
errors.systemReserved: That shortcut is reserved by the operating system.
errors.conflict: That shortcut is already used by another action.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save the shortcut. Try again.

state.idle: Check to see if a newer version is available.
state.error: Couldn't check for updates. Try again later.

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Add a provider once, then point each agent at the provider and model it should use.

pool.heading: Provider pool
pool.empty: No providers yet. Add one to get started.

form.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored key
form.aliasHint: Alias: a shorter or agent-consistent name written to the agent instead of the model ID (e.g. a long id shortened, or a gateway's custom name). Falls back to the model ID when blank.
form.keySavedHidden: A key is saved · hidden for security. Leave blank to keep it, or type to replace.

agent.restoreConfirm: Restore this agent's config to before AiOpt?

binding.title: Choose provider
binding.help: Pick a provider and model, then Apply.
binding.modelHint: Model (optional — defaults to the first, change anytime)
binding.selectProviderHint: Select a provider on the left to see its models.

errors.INVALID_PARAMS: Some details are invalid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That provider or model no longer exists.
errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: A provider with that id already exists.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: This provider's format needs a proxy for this agent (coming later).
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: This agent can't be configured yet.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: The provider rejected the API key. Check the key and try again.
errors.UPSTREAM_ERROR: Couldn't load models from the provider. Check the Base URL and try again.

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: Token and request counts for traffic AiOpt routed through the translation proxy.
usage.scopeNote: Traffic is counted when it runs through the proxy. With proxy mode on, every binding does, so usage is measured. By default (proxy mode off) same-format bindings connect directly and aren’t counted; Gemini bindings are always direct and never counted.
usage.empty: No usage recorded yet. Turn on proxy mode, bind an agent to a provider, and run a request. By default (proxy mode off) same-format bindings bypass the proxy and aren’t measured; Gemini bindings are never measured.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Collect skills from each agent's home directory into one central library, then sync them back out.
skills.emptyHint: Import a skill folder, or pull one an agent already has into the library.

confirm.pushAll: Overwrite this skill in every agent with the library copy?
confirm.delete: Delete this skill from the central library? Agent copies are left untouched.
confirm.deleteAgent: Delete this agent's copy of the skill? The library and other agents' copies are left untouched.
confirm.deleteAgentLast: This is the only copy of this skill — the library and every other agent are without it. Deleting it can't be undone. Delete anyway?
confirm.overwriteAgent: Overwrite the agent's copy with the library copy?
confirm.overwriteLibrary: Overwrite the library copy with the agent's copy?
confirm.merge: Apply the picked agent files to the library copy? The agent's copy is left untouched.

diff.title: Changes
diff.mergeHint: Files set to “Use agent” are written to the library; the rest keep the library version.

errors.INVALID_PARAMS: Some details are invalid. Try again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: That action isn't permitted, or the skill contains files that can't be synced safely.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: That skill is too large to sync.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: This agent has no known skills directory.
